signatureComponents.target: Up to two allies within 3 squares that can see or hear your Aid signal.
signatureComponents.duration: Each Boon expires when used or the start of your next turn.
signatureComponents.effect:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Up to two allies within 3 squares that can see or hear your Aid signal.

When you use Aid, you may assist two allies instead of one. Name the task for each and explain how your signal helps. Each gains Aid’s normal 1 Boon to its next matching roll before the start of your next turn. Outside combat, Aid still replaces your own contribution to a group roll.

**Duration:** Each Boon expires when used or the start of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Your signal may be speech, signs or music the recipients can perceive.

**Frequency:** One two-recipient Aid on your turn.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.effect: Turn a cutting phrase into a psychic sting. Deal 2/3/5 mental damage.

spells.name: Heroism
spells.effect: Bolster its courage. Reduce Frightened by 2 immediately and grant 1 Boon to rolls made while confronting a visible source of fear.

spells.name: Charm Person
spells.duration: Until the social exchange ends, up to 10 minutes
spells.effect: Offer an appealing introduction. Add 1/2/3 progress toward an attainable social objective involving a friendly hearing or small favor. During the exchange, the target senses you as approachable. The DA establishes the concession and its boundaries before casting.

spells.name: Calm Emotions
spells.effect: Send a steadying hush through the group. Reduce each target's Frightened by 1/2/3. Willing listeners may also pause an argument long enough for one person to speak.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.effect: Create a simple sound or stationary visual image. An image is insubstantial; a sound can be as loud as ordinary speech. Physical interaction reveals the illusion. You can keep one Minor Illusion at a time.

spells.name: Silent Image
spells.effect: Shape a silent moving image. A Maneuver may move it up to 3 squares and alter its gestures. Physical interaction reveals its insubstantial nature; observers may examine it using the shared illusion procedure. Without directing it, the image stays in place and repeats its last simple performance.

spells.name: Message
spells.effect: Whisper a message of up to ten words into the recipient's hearing. It may answer with up to ten words as part of the exchange. The message travels through ordinary ambient noise.

spells.name: Comprehend Languages
spells.effect: Understand the literal meaning of one language at a time. Read at an ordinary pace. Cultural references, ciphers and deliberate codes retain their own interpretation challenges.

castingBudget.note: Alternative uses of the same reserve, not simultaneous allocations. Assumes SP is spent before recovery; time, spell-specific limits, components and maintained actions still apply. Signature spells and conditional discounts are described separately.

builds.resolved: Musical Aid and commanded attacks coexist with emotion/perception utility. Negotiation develops one technique instead of accumulating three unrelated social buttons.
builds.remaining: Bardic Inspiration remains an immediate coordinated contribution rather than a banked die. Social objectives still depend on the DA and the situation.

spells.name: Heroism

spells.name: Calm Emotions

spells.name: Message

spells.name: Suggestion

spells.name: Fear
spells.effect: Appear as an overwhelming source of dread. Apply Frightened 1/2/3, with you as its source. Each creature retains control of its movement and decisions.

spells.name: Dreams
spells.effect: Share one brief harmless dream image or soothing sensation. The sleeper later remembers it as a dream. Ordinary waking ends the exchange.

spells.name: Sleep

spells.name: Dream Message

spells.name: Phantasmal Force
spells.effect: Create a troubling sensory image that only the target perceives. Apply Frightened 1/2/3, naming the image as its source. Each upkeep renews Frightened 1. spells.name: Dream
spells.effect: Meet in a shared dream with speech and vivid images. Each participant can recall the exchange afterward. The dream ends if either wakes; you can show remembered experiences as you recall them.

spells.name: Sign of Sleep

spells.name: Lord Dream

spells.name: Weird
spells.effect: Surround the targets with personalized waking terrors. Roll once; each takes 3/5/7 mental damage and gains Frightened 2, with the visions as source until your next turn ends.

spells.name: Astral Projection

spells.name: Charm Monster
spells.duration: One social objective, up to 10 minutes

spells.name: Confusion
spells.effect: Scatter attention with conflicting impulses. Apply Dazed 1/1/2. Each affected creature chooses its remaining action categories normally when its turn begins.

spells.name: Disguise Self

spells.name: Mirror Image

spells.name: Invisibility

spells.name: Major Image

spells.name: Greater Invisibility
spells.effect: Make the recipient and carried gear Invisible. It may continue attacking and casting while this effect lasts. Attacking still reveals its location and ends Hidden normally.

spells.name: Hallucinatory Terrain

spells.name: Detect Thoughts

spells.name: Tongues

spells.name: Sending

spells.name: Boil Liquid
spells.effect: Bring its liquid to a rolling boil. The liquid then cools naturally; handle it with suitable protection.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.effect: Sweep your hands outward in a fan of flame. Deal 2/3/5 fire damage to each creature in the cone.

spells.name: Heat Metal
spells.effect: Heat the item until it glows. Its wearer or holder takes 2/3/5 fire damage when cast. Each later upkeep deals 1 fire damage to a creature still touching the item; this continuing heat is not an attack and resistance can reduce it to 0. A holder may drop it immediately after damage. Worn items take their normal removal time. The heat ends when Sustain ends.

spells.name: Elementalism — Air
spells.effect: Stir a light breeze to turn pages, scatter loose dust, ring a small chime or move the object 1 square along a surface. The breeze can extinguish a candle-sized flame.

spells.name: Feather Fall
spells.duration: Until it lands, up to 1 minute
spells.effect: A cushion of air slows the descent to 2 squares each round. The recipient lands upright and unharmed from this fall if the destination supports it.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.effect: Turn a cutting phrase into a psychic sting. Deal 2/3/5 mental damage.

spells.name: Heroism
spells.effect: Bolster its courage. Reduce Frightened by 2 immediately and grant 1 Boon to rolls made while confronting a visible source of fear.

spells.name: Ray of Frost
spells.effect: Send a needle of frost into the target. Deal 2/3/5 cold damage.

spells.name: Create or Destroy Water
spells.effect: Create up to 10 liters of ordinary clean water or remove that quantity of free-standing water. Water inside living creatures and sealed vessels stays unchanged.

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.effect: Loose three fiery rays. Roll once for a shared total of 4/6/9 fire damage. Divide that total between the chosen targets before resistance, assigning at least 1 to each. Each target takes one damage event.

spells.name: Wall of Fire
spells.effect: Raise a wall of flame 2 squares high. Roll when cast to set its fire damage at 3/5/7. A creature takes that damage the first time each round it enters the wall or ends its turn there. Treat each creature once per round across all squares of this wall. Keep one Wall of Fire active; casting another ends the first.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.effect: A bead of fire bursts into a roaring sphere. Deal 3/5/8 fire damage to every creature in the burst, including allies. Exposed unattended flammable material ignites.

spells.name: Fire Shield
spells.effect: Wreathe yourself in protective heat. Gain cold resistance 2. A creature that damages you with an adjacent melee attack takes 2 fire damage after its attack resolves, once per attacker per round.

spells.name: Fog Cloud
spells.effect: Gather an opaque bank of fog that blocks sight through its area. Strong wind disperses the cloud. Creatures may navigate by other senses and remembered positions.

spells.name: Gust of Wind
spells.effect: Drive a powerful gust along the line. Push each affected creature 1/2/3 squares away from you and disperse ordinary smoke or fog in the line. Stability applies to the push.

spells.name: Fire Storm
spells.effect: Trace a winding furnace across the battlefield. Deal 4/7/10 fire damage to each creature in the chosen squares. Each creature is affected once; exposed unattended flammable objects ignite.

spells.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
spells.effect: Place a glowing bead at the point. On casting, or after a later upkeep, you may detonate it. Roll on detonation for 4/6/9 fire damage, adding 1 damage per completed upkeep, maximum +2. Ending sustain or touching the bead detonates it immediately. Every creature in the burst is affected once.

spells.name: Meteor Swarm
spells.effect: Call a fall of blazing meteors onto the chosen points. Roll once; every creature within 1 square of a point takes 4/7/10 fire damage, including allies. Overlapping bursts affect a creature once. Exposed unattended flammable objects ignite.

spells.name: Levitate
spells.effect: Lift the recipient up to 3 squares above its starting height. Each upkeep can raise or lower it 2 squares, keeping it within 6 squares of you. It can pull itself along reachable solid surfaces using movement. On expiry it descends safely up to 3 squares, then falls normally.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.effect: Send a crackling stroke along the line. Deal 3/5/7 lightning damage to each creature, once each.

spells.name: Fly
spells.effect: The recipient flies using its normal Speed and movement. On expiry it descends safely up to 3 squares; remaining unsupported distance is a normal fall.

spells.name: Wind Wall
spells.effect: Raise a wind barrier 3 squares high. Physical ranged attacks through it receive 2 Banes. The wall disperses ordinary airborne smoke and gas in its squares. Creatures pass through at an extra movement cost of 1 per wall square.

spells.name: Charm Person
spells.duration: Until the social exchange ends, up to 10 minutes

spells.name: Calm Emotions

spells.name: Suggestion
spells.duration: One social objective, up to 10 minutes

spells.name: Fear
spells.effect: Appear as an overwhelming source of dread. Apply Frightened 1/2/3, with you as its source. Each creature retains control of its movement and decisions.

spells.name: Charm Monster

spells.effect: Establish rapport through shared sensations even across a language barrier. Add 2/4/6 progress toward a feasible request stated by the DA. The creature's needs and motives shape what you can ask of it.

spells.name: Confusion
spells.effect: Scatter attention with conflicting impulses. Apply Dazed 1/1/2. Each affected creature chooses its remaining action categories normally when its turn begins.

spells.effect: Press a spirit-binding command to halt, retreat up to its Speed, or release a held object. The creature chooses to obey using its own actions or take 3/5/7 radiant damage and Frightened 1. A player decides that choice for their own creature.

spells.name: Contact Other Plane
spells.effect: Ask one question. Weak brings a truthful but symbolic clue, Standard a direct answer within the source's knowledge, and Strong adds a relevant warning or lead. The DA establishes the source's identity and disposition through the contact.

spells.name: Unseen Servant
spells.effect: Call a Clay Helper energy form from Summoned Companions. Its appearance is a faint translucent outline. Use its printed profile, immediate Main command, six-square tether and continuing commands for chores and movement.

spells.name: Summon Animal
spells.effect: Summon one Animal profile rated 1 from Summoned Companions. Give its immediate Main command, then use the normal command, six-square tether and disappearance rules.

spells.name: Phantom Steed
spells.effect: Shape a spectral riding horse using the Warhorse summoned profile. Give its immediate Main command. Continue directing it through the normal command procedure; movement carries its rider using the ordinary mounted movement rules and six-square tether.

spells.name: Conjure Animals
spells.effect: Call one Animal profile rated 3 or lower. It may appear as a small pack moving as one form: use that single profile, footprint and shared HP. Give one immediate Main command and use the normal command and tether rules.

spells.name: Conjure Elemental
spells.effect: Call one Elemental profile rated 3 or lower. Use its printed statistics, immediate Main command, normal command economy and six-square tether.

spells.name: Summon Dragon
spells.effect: Manifest a serpentine storm-dragon using the Storm Column summoned profile. Its shape expresses the spell; use that profile's movement, attacks and defenses. Give one immediate Main command, then normal commands and the six-square tether.

spells.name: Disguise Self
spells.effect: Change your apparent face, clothing and proportions within your existing size. Your voice and tangible shape remain physical. Touch reveals mismatches; close inspection uses the shared illusion procedure.

spells.name: Mirror Image
spells.duration: 1 minute or until three attacks resolve against you
spells.effect: Create three shifting doubles. Gain 1 Boon to defenses against attacks that depend on seeing you. After each such attack resolves, one double vanishes. The remaining doubles provide the same single Boon.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.effect: Make the recipient and its carried gear Invisible. Attacking or casting another spell ends this casting's invisibility after that action resolves. Other senses can still locate the recipient.

spells.name: Major Image
spells.effect: Create a moving illusion with sound, scent and harmless temperature. A Maneuver can move it 3 squares and change its performance. Touch reveals its insubstantial nature. It may conceal a real feature visually; physical terrain remains as it was. Without directing it, the image stays in place and repeats its last simple performance.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.effect: A spectral hand lifts and moves the object up to 2 squares, or opens one unlocked door or container. It handles ordinary items with simple motions. Each new manipulation uses another casting.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.effect: Send luminous darts along clear paths. Roll once for a shared total of 3/5/7 force damage; divide it before resistance, assigning at least 1 to each target. Each target takes one damage event.

Escape or ending Sustain removes this casting’s Slowed.

For an item with HP, the DA states before casting whether this small repair is sufficient and how many HP it restores, following the repair-objective rules. Missing components and substantial reconstruction use repair projects.

spells.name: Prestidigitation
spells.effect: Clean or soil a hand-sized surface, change a small object's harmless scent or color, or create a tiny visual spark. Choose one effect when casting; its physical scale remains hand-sized.

spells.name: Unseen Servant — Workshop
spells.effect: Create a Clay Helper energy form from Summoned Companions. Give its immediate Main command. Use its printed abilities, normal commands and six-square tether for workshop chores; provide real tools and materials.

spells.name: Light
spells.effect: Make it shed bright light to 6 squares and dim light for another 3. Choose the color. You may keep one Light casting at a time and end it with a Maneuver.

spells.name: Magic Weapon
spells.effect: Give the weapon's damaging attacks +1 physical damage before resistance. Apply this once per target per attack. Use the highest magical weapon damage increase.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.effect: Sense whether an active magical effect is present on the target. Learn whether the strongest visible aura is protective, transformative, harmful or informative. To investigate a concealed source, first expose it or use a spell that can examine it through the concealment.

spells.name: Detect Poison and Disease
spells.effect: Determine whether ordinary poison or disease is present and identify its broad type: ingested, inhaled, contact or bodily infection. The reading helps select suitable treatment.

castingBudget.note: Alternative uses of the same reserve, not simultaneous allocations. Assumes SP is spent before recovery; time, spell-specific limits, components and maintained actions still apply. Signature spells and conditional discounts are described separately.

builds.resolved: Make It Last now creates a persistent bound item, then two and three with reviewed properties. This directly addresses the previous inability to represent enduring magical inventions.
builds.remaining: The small curated properties are not the full 5e replication catalog. Each binding needs its actual ordinary item and tools; these drafts supply tools, while a chosen lamp/shield would need a separate purchased item.
